data.long_meaning: Derived from the Italian name 'Emmanuele', which means 'God with us' in Hebrew. The name was popularized in Italy during the Middle Ages and has since become a common name in many Western countries. The name Manuele carries the meaning “God with us” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Manuele usually hope their child will grow to embody god with us and live with faith, good character and purpose.
